api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — pending spec clarification: (1) DATA-DOM message gaps carried into SVC-API: an unread query without name/detail (RefusalReason UNREAD_QUERY_INCOMPLETE, RULE-RPT-007) is raised as FindingIncompleteException RPT-422-FINDING-INCOMPLETE and a document outcome without a documentType (DOCUMENT_INCOMPLETE, RULE-RPT-008) as DocumentReasonMismatchException RPT-422-DOCUMENT-REASON-MISMATCH, both with the table's own generic text 'The report of Check {checkId} was not stored.' (key RPT-500-REPORT-NOT-STORED) since the plan states no message for either — no text invented; the factory should supply both messages. (2) CON-CHK-008 lets ReportDocumentOutcome.documentType be null for a host document whose type was NULL, but RULE-RPT-008 + DOCUMENT_TYPE NOT NULL refuse it, so such a report is refused and CHK fails the Check INTERNAL_ERROR. (3) getCheck: SVC-API says none -> RPT-404-CHECK-NOT-FOUND, the declared CheckResultPort returns Optional — implemented as an empty Optional. (4) RULE-RPT-006 is applied where CHK's String codes are mapped (CheckResultStore, fromStored), so an unknown code is refused before RULE-RPT-001 (createCheckRun) / RULE-RPT-010 (failCheck) presence checks when both apply; blank codes count as absent. (5) ADR-RPT-012(3) says a write failure rolls CHK's transaction back whole (Check stays RUNNING), while SVC-API completeCheck step 4 and CHK's CheckEndingService roll back to a savepoint and fail INTERNAL_ERROR; RPT declares ReportNotStoredException rollbackFor and leaves the savepoint to CHK. (6) API-RPT-002/003 query params maxLength 100 have no error code: not validated (an over-long value matches nothing). (7) Purge kept/deleted log lines (REQ-RPT-054, REQ-RPT-046) appended as message keys RPT-LOG-PURGE-KEPT / RPT-LOG-PURGE-DELETED. (8) M.5 ArchUnit boundary test still deferred (tests not allowed this run).

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: completeCheck write failure: ADR-RPT-012(3) whole-transaction rollback vs REQ-CHK-048 failCheck in the same transaction
api_doc_gaps.detail: Plan statements: (a) RPT ADR-RPT-012(3) + PORTS + SVC-API completeCheck step 4 — a database failure during the report writes propagates as ReportNotStoredException (RPT-500-REPORT-NOT-STORED) and rolls back the caller's WHOLE transaction: the report and the Check Engine's Active Check DELETE are undone together, the Check stays RUNNING and its deadline later ends it (REQ-RPT-009, AC-RPT-062). (b) CHK CON-CHK-008 / REQ-CHK-048 / ADR-CHK-015 (CheckEndingService.handOverReport) — on 'not stored' CHK rolls back to a savepoint taken before completeCheck and calls failCheck(INTERNAL_ERROR) IN THE SAME transaction. Both cannot hold. RPT's CheckResultStore and CheckRunCommandService (Propagation.REQUIRED, rollbackFor = ReportNotStoredException, which wins over noRollbackFor = RptRefusalException by Spring's closest-rule depth; the default rule would roll back any RuntimeException anyway) end the participating transaction with rollback: JpaTransactionObject.setRollbackOnly marks the JPA EntityTransaction rollback-only, and Hibernate marks it itself on a flush PersistenceException. JpaTransactionObject.rollbackToSavepoint resets only the EntityManagerHolder flag, so the EntityTransaction stays rollback-only and the ending commit fails with UnexpectedRollbackException: CHK's failCheck(INTERNAL_ERROR) and its Active Check DELETE roll back too. Current behaviour (static reading of src + spring-orm 7.0.9 / Hibernate 7.4.5 bytecode; not executed — tests disallowed): the exception leaves CheckEndingService.end, CheckPipeline.run's catch maps it (PipelineFailure default) to INTERNAL_ERROR and calls ending.fail in a NEW REQUIRES_NEW transaction; the Active Check row is back, the DELETE hits 1 row and RPT failCheck moves the still-RUNNING Check run to FAILED / INTERNAL_ERROR with the CHK-500 text. Only if that second ending also fails does PipelineRunner log it and the deadline check end the Check FAILED / TIMED_OUT (REQ-CHK-080). Related (CHK/REG, reported in ALIGN-BE-RPT-v1-2026-10-02 X2, not recorded here): JpaTransactionManager + HibernateJpaDialect exposes no SavepointManager (HibernateJpaDialect.SessionTransactionData does not implement it), so status.createSavepoint() in handOverReport throws NestedTransactionNotSupportedException before completeCheck is reached and the same pipeline catch ends the Check FAILED / INTERNAL_ERROR. In every path the outcome is recorded (FAILED / INTERNAL_ERROR, or FAILED / TIMED_OUT via the deadline check), never silent, and no part of the report remains (REQ-RPT-009 holds). Decision needed: which plan statement wins — RPT keeps whole-rollback (then CHK's REQ-CHK-048 must end the Check in a new transaction), or RPT must leave the caller's transaction usable on a write failure (then ADR-RPT-012(3) changes and the savepoint mechanism must exist).

A request with an Accept header the endpoint cannot produce (e.g. text/plain) answers RPT-500 because the error catalog has no 406/400 code for it; INT maps the same case to INT-400-REQUEST-INVALID. The factory is asked for a code (406 or 400) to add to the RPT error-catalog and API document.
